clauses.text: For columns, the shortest cross-sectional dimension shall not be less than 300 mm and the ratio of the shortest cross-sectional dimension to the perpendicular dimension shall not be less than 0.4.
clauses.notes:
Shortest cross-sectional dimension - The smaller of the two principal cross-sectional dimensions of the member.

For columns and seismic frame members:

The smallest side of the cross-section must be at least 300 mm.
The member cannot be excessively long and narrow.
The smaller dimension must be at least 40% of the larger dimension.

Cross-sectional area is the area of a member when it is cut by a plane perpendicular to its length.
